prompt: That bag looks heavy. I ___ (carry) it for you.
explanation: Es una decisión tomada en ese instante, así que toca will y no going to.

prompt: I think it ___ (rain) tomorrow afternoon.
explanation: I think introduce una predicción sin pruebas: will.

prompt: Don't worry, I ___ (not / tell) anyone your secret.
explanation: Una promesa se hace con will; la negativa es will not, contraída won't.

prompt: ___ (you / help) me with these boxes, please?
explanation: Las peticiones y ofrecimientos van con will delante del sujeto.

prompt: She ___ (be) twenty-five next month.
They probably ___ (not / finish) the report tonight.

prompt: The phone is ringing. I ___ (answer) it.

prompt: He will come to the meeting.
solution: He will not come to the meeting.
explanation: will not, contraído won't; el verbo se queda en infinitivo: won't come.

prompt: They will arrive before dinner.
explanation: Will pasa delante del sujeto y el verbo no cambia: Will they arrive?

prompt: I am sure you will pass the exam next week.
explanation: I am sure marca una opinión sobre el futuro, no un plan: will, no going to.

prompt: Someone is at the door. I will open it.
explanation: La decisión se toma en ese momento, y eso pide will.

prompt: I will call you as soon as the train arrives.
explanation: La acción principal lleva will; tras as soon as se usa present simple, aunque ambas acciones sean futuras.
